fields.description:
Prepare the committed helper and a verified real rehearsal artifact needed by the reclaim window. This story performs no remote ref deletion and never pushes. A6-1 alone refreshes the bundle if `origin/tickets` moved, deletes the identified pins, and publishes the rewrite after all writers are quiesced. Session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4 contains the measured facts.

## Context

The remote tag `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` and host-local tag `refs/tags/pre-a3-remediation` retain pre-rewrite history. An in-repository backup branch or tag would defeat reclamation, so rollback material must be a bundle stored outside every Git worktree and Git directory. The helper must derive live ref OIDs at execution time rather than trust the measured counts or hardcoded object IDs.

## Plan

- Add `infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py`, a stock-Git CLI that runs only in a clean, unfiltered clone. It accepts the old tickets tip, an off-repo bundle path, a JSON manifest path, and repeatable pin-ref names.
- Enumerate `git ls-remote --heads --tags origin` at run time, collapse annotated-tag `^{}` lines onto their canonical refs, and record every default-clone head/tag with its exact direct and peeled OID. For each commit tip, record one deterministic relationship to the old tip: same, old-tip-is-ancestor, ref-is-ancestor, diverged-with-merge-base, unrelated, or non-commit. This makes every ancestry intersection explicit without hardcoding a ref count.
- Resolve each requested pin by name from the live enumeration or the local clone. Refuse missing/non-commit pins. Create temporary local backup refs for the old tip and pin tips, build the bundle from only those explicit refs, verify it, then remove the temporary refs.
- Refuse partial/promisor clones and any bundle or manifest path inside the repository, its Git directory, or another registered worktree. Create parent directories only outside those boundaries and fail rather than overwrite an existing artifact.
- Prove the bundle by restoring it into a throwaway repository and comparing the restored old-tip and pin-tip object IDs exactly. Snapshot the protected source refs before and after and assert that preparation performed no push, delete, or remote mutation.
- Run the helper against a fresh real unfiltered clone and store the rehearsal bundle/manifest outside the repository. Record absolute paths, SHA-256 checksums, sizes, old tip, pin tips, and `git bundle verify` output on this ticket. A6-1 must create a fresh final bundle after quiescence whenever its observed old tip differs from this rehearsal manifest.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [code-verifiable] A real-repository integration test proves the helper enumerates all live origin heads/tags at run time, de-peels annotated tags, and records exact OIDs without a hardcoded count. Tier: temporary real Git remotes.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The manifest assigns every enumerated commit ref exactly one old-tip relationship and records non-commit refs without attempting ancestry operations on them. Tier: temporary real Git remotes with ancestor, descendant, diverged, unrelated, annotated-tag, and blob-ref fixtures.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The helper refuses any promisor/partial clone with a nonzero exit and an operator-readable fresh-unfiltered-clone remedy. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The helper refuses bundle or manifest destinations inside the repository, its Git directory, or another registered worktree, and refuses to overwrite an existing artifact. Tier: CLI integration with real worktrees.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The created bundle contains named refs for the exact old tip and every requested pin tip, and `git bundle verify` succeeds. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Restoring the bundle into a throwaway repository reproduces the old-tip and every requested pin-tip SHA exactly. Tier: real Git restore integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A recording Git wrapper proves the helper invokes no push or remote delete, while exact before/after origin heads/tags remain byte-identical. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A failed verification removes incomplete bundle/manifest artifacts and temporary local backup refs, and a clean retry succeeds. Tier: fault-injected real-repository integration.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A real unfiltered-clone rehearsal records the off-repo bundle and manifest absolute paths, SHA-256 checksums, byte sizes, observed old tip, included pin tips, and successful `git bundle verify` output on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The rehearsal comment states that A6-1 must recreate the final bundle if the quiet-window old tip differs and confirms no remote ref was deleted or changed by A6-0d.

## Verification commands

- `pytest tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py -v`
- `make lint`
- `make typecheck`
- `make test`

## Scope

`infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py` and `tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py`. No source-module, configuration, or remote-ref mutation. Scope: M. Depends on closed A6-0c; A6-1 consumes the helper and owns final refresh/deletion/publication.
